description: This file defines a specification class 'CatalogItemsSpecification' used to query 'CatalogItem' entities based on their IDs in the application core of the eShopOnWeb project.

classes.name: CatalogItemsSpecification
classes.description: A specification class for querying catalog items by a list of IDs, inheriting from Ardalis.Specification.Specification<CatalogItem>.

methods.name: CatalogItemsSpecification
methods.description: Constructor that filters 'CatalogItem' entities to those whose IDs are in the provided 'ids' array.
